FN-9WHOPM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 36
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/10/2023
Senate Bill 36 as introduced increases the competitive bidding floor for county and city boards
of education from $15,000, under current law, to $25,000. This may increase or decrease the
cost of purchasing or leasing products and services, depending on the difference in (1) the price
that could be obtained from competitive bidding contracts pursuant to this bill and (2) the price
otherwise obtained under current law.
